products.title: DeepCool ASSASSIN IV Premium CPU Air Cooler, Dual-Tower, 120/140mm FDB Fan Configuration, 7 Copper Heat Pipes, Quiet/Peformance Mode Switch
products.body_html:
ASSASSIN IV

The ASSASSIN returns with a new white aesthetic and efficient cooling capacity. The ASSASSIN IV WH provides exceptional performance and is armed with seven heat pipes and newly designed 120 and 140mm FDB fans.

  • Quiet or Performance: Change between quiet 22.6 dB(A) and Performance modes by simply flipping a switch.
  • Sleek, Clean, and Functional: The majestic shroud, which houses dual-tower heat sinks with seven copper heat pipes, channels all the airflow through the entire cooler.
  • Specialized 120/140m Fan Configuration: Designed with a quiet and efficient 3-phase 6-pole fan motor, the 120/140mm fans provides optimal air flow at a low noise level.
  • Industrial Grade Thermal Paste: A tube of DeepCool's industrial grade DM9 thermal paste is included.
  • Maximum Compatibility: Supports the vast majority of modern Intel and AMD CPUs while the relocatable 120mm fan ensures maximum compatibility for high profile RGB RAM modules.
  • Dimensions: 147(L) x 148(W) x 164mm(H)
  • RAM clearance:
    • Intel LGA1700/1200/115X: Unobstructed
    • Intel LGA20XX: 63mm
    • AMD: AM4/AM5: Unobstructed

products.body_html: • Scythe flagship model Fuma 3 is a high-end dual tower CPU air cooler.
